name: recover
instructions: Priority: recovery is a checkpoint in the SAME authorized Maker preparation run, not a final status or request to continue. On generic unknown/expired interruption inspect under an owned lease: saved/reopened first_time_draft uses guarded same-attempt record_preparation recovery; only proven no recipient/draft/effects uses guarded retry_unsaved_preparation. After success continue through quote, verified draft and Pulse ready readback. Saved corrections use retry_recipient_creation. Stop only for ready/readback, human send, concrete external-action blocker or user cancellation; report safe code, actual httpStatus and specific next action.

For a phone/email validation failure before anything was saved in Remitly, Maker owns the retry. With a current owned browser lease, inspect the current provider contact/draft/history state and call pulse_payout_retry_recipient_creation with the latest recipientCorrection.hash, current unknown/expired attempt, fresh observedAt, sourceUrl, stable observationId, protected evidence and historyCoverage. Confirm noRecipientSaved and noDraftSaved plus historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers and previousDraftClosed. Absence of a recipient/draft satisfies inspection and closure only when actually verified; recipientCorrectionApplied means the corrected saved details will be used by the fresh attempt. Never invent a record or claim an edit to an absent contact. Saved draft/contact markers, recorded payment/link/activity, human decline/release, mixed name/other errors, stale corrections or paused preparation block this retry. Success keeps the SAME withdrawal and coins reserved, closes the failed internal attempt, applies the saved correction and clears the old quote/check. Continue with one continuous preparation job: claim with prepare without quoteHash, get the quote and save the scheduled draft, then report both through record_preparation; checker review and human final sending remain required.
Stop browser actions and scheduled work for the affected role/account before attempting recovery. Never delete local or backend leases to force parallel access.
Read the existing backend attempt and audit history. Record what was observed and what remains unknown; retain all coin reservations while an action may have reached Remitly.

On an expired/lost browser or attempt lease, stop provider mutations and inspect current contacts/drafts/activity under a fresh owned browser lease. For a generic unknown/expired interruption, an existing saved/reopened first_time_draft goes through guarded record_preparation recovery on the SAME attempt with final quote and verified draft, never recreation. Saved scheduled/legacy unknown attempts remain in existing-record investigation without automatic replay. Only proven absence of recipient, draft and effects permits guarded Maker pulse_payout_retry_unsaved_preparation; generic unknown alone is insufficient. A saved phone/email correction uses retry_recipient_creation instead. Continue authorized preparation immediately after successful guarded recovery.

Browser logout/MFA/CAPTCHA requires human session recovery. Changed provider selectors, unverified link patterns, method restrictions or changed account identity require an updated validated playbook; do not guess.
An expired scheduled draft is not proof of funding return or absence of other drafts. Verify actual provider cancellation/return and historical coverage before releasing coins or retrying.

A human decline before any provider attempt can cancel and refund through the protected backend. A decline after an attempt blocks release and retains coins until provider reconciliation verifies resolution.

Revoked/expired role credentials stop the job. The owner issues a replacement credential for the same intended environment/account/role, and the local Mac Keychain stores it without putting the token in commands, files or logs.

A crashed local run keeps its local lock. Confirm its process is stopped, record provider investigation in the backend and note the expected run ID before using the explicit local recovery command. Local cleanup does not change backend state or authorize another provider action.

If computer sleep/app closure interrupts an automation, treat possible provider actions as uncertain; no catch-up run may blindly replay draft creation. Obtain new identity/health checks and leases on resume.

If browser capability or custom MCP access is unavailable in the actual Codex automation, report the blocked capability and leave the item unchanged. Manual installation/verification is separate from delivery of this package.
Complete with only a redacted status/count summary. The human alone performs final sending or link issuance; recovery does not waive that boundary.

Guarded recovery is explicitly approved. With a current owned browser lease, only the reconciler may call pulse_payout_resolve_recipient_error for the latest recipientCorrection.hash and current unknown/expired attempt. Independently verify the corrected contact and relevant provider history; all nine checks must be true: historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers, previousDraftClosed. Any recorded human decline/release, provider transfer reference/activity or issued link blocks recovery. Use signed-in sourceUrl, fresh observedAt, stable observationId, historyCoverage and protected evidence. Success definitively closes the old attempt, applies corrected snapshot/version, clears old quote/check and returns the SAME withdrawal to awaiting_quote with coins still reserved. Never send automatically; maker performs continuous quote-and-draft preparation, checker independently checks, and human sends.

recipientCorrectionApplied permits two evidence branches: an existing provider contact was updated, OR inspection confirmed no provider contact was persisted and the next fresh preparation will use the corrected details. Record which branch in protected evidence. Mixed rejected name/other fields cannot be cleared by phone/email recovery; investigate those errors separately.

A saved phone/email correction is sufficient user input; never demand another edit, recovery form or quote approval. Maker uses retry_recipient_creation for verified unsaved validation failures. For generic unknown/expired interruption only, Maker may call pulse_payout_retry_unsaved_preparation with current attemptId/expectedVersion, fresh observationId/sourceUrl/observedAt, protected evidence/historyCoverage and true historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, noRecipientSaved, noDraftSaved, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers and previousDraftClosed. Require proven absence of provider records/effects, exact reservation/snapshot/version, owned lease, unpaused state, and no active recipient validation issue or saved correction. Success cancels the old failed INTERNAL attempt, retains the SAME withdrawal and coins, returns awaiting_quote, and Maker continues prepare without quoteHash through quote, verified draft and readback now. If a draft exists, use guarded record_preparation recovery of that SAME attempt with current expectedVersion, fresh observationId/sourceUrl/observedAt, evidence/historyCoverage and true historyInspected, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers; verify exact binding/reservation/snapshot and reopen the same draft. Never use generic unknown to save progress or erase a saved correction. Reconciliation verifies sent outcomes; uncertain effects remain for investigation. Report safe code, actual httpStatus and specific external action for a concrete blocker.
